pages.raw_meta: Resolute Holdings (NYSE: RHLD) is a publicly traded management company responsible for overseeing the operations and capital allocation strategies of CompoSecure (NYSE: CMPO).
raw_blocks: Resolute Holdings (NYSE: RHLD) is a publicly traded management company responsible for overseeing the operations and capital allocation strategies of GPGI, Inc. (NYSE: GPGI). Through this structure, Resolute is the manager of a permanent capital platform and is focused on acquiring high-quality businesses that can achieve their full potential through the implementation and deployment of the Resolute Operating System.
Good Industry: Growing, profitable, can differentiate, recurring a plus.
Great Position: Great market position or possible to get there.
Differentiate with Technology: Increase R&D for innovation funded with operational efficiency.
Organic Growth: Invigorate go-to-market and innovation.
Margin Expansion: Increase variable margin, grow sales faster than fixed costs.
